narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for 'Shopee Video,' a new short-form content feature on the Shopee app. It uses the popular 'Huang Brothers' influencers to explain how users can buy products directly through videos, sell their own second-hand items for charity, and join the affiliate program to earn commissions, all wrapped in an energetic and humorous narrative.
